bio: Among the finest seafood restaurants in the area, it enjoys a privileged position directly on the Viareggio promenade, a few steps from the sea, with an outdoor terrace particularly pleasant to enjoy during the warmer months. In the kitchen is a chef of undoubted talent, capable of ensuring raw materials of exceptional quality combined with sound, personal technique. Among the signature dishes stand out the octopus alla plancia with panissa and tomato chutney, as well as the salt cod in breadstick crust accompanied by chickpea cream and sautéed cavolo nero. In the dining room, courtesy and professionalism are very much in evidence, supported by an extensive and well-chosen wine list, rich in interesting labels.
